nativeRoute: CICD GitLab OAuth → system JWT → browser task session

loginFlow.steps: 复用宿主安全注入 CICD_TOKEN，先执行 source-verified Bearer /api/user/info；缺失则通过 web-access 复用页面 session 或点击 GitLab 登录由用户完成 SSO/MFA。网页 TOKEN__ nested cache 需要专用 adapter，不提取 raw key。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: 前端 TOKEN__ 位于带前缀 COMMON__LOCAL__KEY__ 缓存结构；不能当成 localStorage 单一 token key。源码含 query token callback，页面 URL 不能原样记录。
subjectPermission: 候选 GET /api/user/info，code=0，result.userId（uint stable ID）；result.username/roles 提供身份与角色上下文。前端 /user/info + API prefix /api + Bearer；部署 SHA 未匹配，仍待 runtime-only probe。上线单/项目/部署权限分别核验。
expiryRevoke: 候选 OAuth 生成系统 JWT 默认 12h；GET /logout handler 只返回 success，没有撤销 JWT。前端清除 TOKEN__/USER__INFO__ 仅清本地会话；服务端撤销/refresh 策略仍待核验。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.fixture: Root integration will run owner-profiles.test.js; not run by this discovery.
verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
